question: Vo väčšine slovenských wellness centier sa do fínskej sauny nesmie v plavkách. Ktorú látku z bazéna by si so sebou mokré plavky priniesli do horúčavy?
source_excerpt: Protesters said a clean bare body in the sauna is healthier than smelly swimsuits full of chlorine.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks often see the textile-free rule as a foreign or prudish curiosity. Learning it has a practical chemical reason turns an awkward rule into an 'aha'. The player can reason it out: what does a swimsuit carry from the pool?
extra.verification_notes: Chlorine from the pool carried in wet swimsuits is a plausible, commonly cited reason for the no-swimsuit rule; the only weakness is that 'water' could also be read as an answer, and I found no Slovak-specific source for the 'most centres' claim or any newer change.

explanation: Zvyšky chlóru z bazénovej vody sa pri vyše osemdesiatich stupňoch odparujú a dráždia dýchacie cesty, preto plavky do sauny nepatria. Syntetická látka navyše bráni pokožke dýchať a potiť sa.

question: Keď saunér počas saunového ceremoniálu poleje rozpálené kamene vodou, teplomer v saune sa takmer nepohne, a predsa vás zaleje vlna horúčavy. Čo sa v saune v skutočnosti prudko zvýši?
source_excerpt: bathers' skin sits below the dew point; vapor condenses onto the skin, releasing heat that makes the steam feel hot

extra.why_interesting: Everyone who has been to a sauna ritual has felt the wave of heat after the ladle hits the stones, and most assume the air simply got hotter. In fact the thermometer barely moves. The heat comes from humidity, which the player can reason toward from everyday experience of muggy summer days.
extra.verification_notes: Throwing water on hot stones sharply raises humidity, so steam condenses on skin and feels hotter while air temperature barely changes (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sauna).

explanation: Para sa zrážajúca na chladnejšej koži odovzdá telu svoje teplo a vlhký vzduch navyše nedovolí potu odparovať sa a chladiť nás. Preto horúčavu cítime oveľa silnejšie, aj keď teplota stojí.
